verzen.tekst: He who touches pitch will be defiled.
verzen.html: He who touches pitch will be defiled.

verzen.tekst: Don’t take up a burden above your strength.
verzen.html: Don’t take up a burden above your strength.

verzen.tekst: The rich man does a wrong and threatens.
verzen.html: The rich man does a wrong and threatens.

verzen.tekst: If you are profitable, he will exploit you.
verzen.html: If you are profitable, he will exploit you.

verzen.tekst: If you own something, he will live with you.
verzen.html: If you own something, he will live with you.

verzen.tekst: Does he need you? Then he will deceive you,
verzen.html: Does he need you? Then he will deceive you,

verzen.tekst: He will shame you by his delicacies
verzen.html: He will shame you by his delicacies

verzen.tekst: Beware that you are not deceived
verzen.html: Beware that you are not deceived

verzen.tekst: If a mighty man invites you, be reserved,
verzen.html: If a mighty man invites you, be reserved,

verzen.tekst: Don’t press him, lest you be thrust back.
verzen.html: Don’t press him, lest you be thrust back.

verzen.tekst: Don’t try to speak with him as an equal,
verzen.html: Don’t try to speak with him as an equal,

verzen.tekst: He who doesn’t keep secrets to himself is unmerciful.
verzen.html: He who doesn’t keep secrets to himself is unmerciful.

verzen.tekst: Keep them to yourself and be careful,
verzen.html: Keep them to yourself and be careful,

verzen.tekst: Every living creature loves its own kind,

verzen.tekst: A rich man speaks, and all keep silence.

verzen.tekst: Riches are good if they have no sin.

verzen.tekst: The heart of a man changes his countenance,
